ledger: Station wagon (cream wood-paneled) | front 3/4 view at start, hood ornament centered on ridge, grille/headlights and plate 'ST 297' facing camera, wood paneling and chrome trim along side, roof rack on top | side-oblique front view at end, front foreshortened and plate cropped out, ornament near left edge of hood, wood trim and side mirror still on same door position | continuous ~30-40 degree arc around front toward side, parallax of hood, fender, and rack evolves smoothly

Woman leaning on door | arms crossed on door/window sill mid-right, facing slightly left of camera | same pose larger in frame, arms still on sill occluding interior | remains anchored to door top, nearer than interior and windshield, occlusion edge stable while hair moves in wind

Antenna + roof rack | thin vertical antenna on front fender left of windshield base, two-bar rack centered on roof | antenna shifts left relative to windshield A-pillar, rack foreshortened in perspective | both remain fixed to body, depth order antenna in front of windshield/hood maintained

Desert road and verge | two-lane asphalt left background with faint yellow dashes, sandy verge and low shrubs | road now centered behind car with clearer dashed centerline receding to horizon, utility poles spaced along horizon | newly revealed length of road and poles compatible with camera moving to reveal more of receding road, no lateral flip

Background terrain (shrub desert + distant mountains) | flat arid plain with scattered yellow-green shrubs, hazy purple mountains under pale sky seen beyond and through windshield | same plain and mountain line, parallax slow vs car (distant), shrubs visible through windshield match exterior | distant background remains stable and continuous, no mismatch between view through glass and exterior

Occlusion stack | foreground: woman/door top and hood > mid: windshield/ A-pillar/roof > background: road/desert/sky, hood occludes grille lower, door occludes interior | same stack enlarged, hood still occludes front, door sill still occludes interior, windshield frame occludes background | depth ordering preserved, no background rendering over foreground, no see-through of opaque panels
